# Lokavia International

> Lokavia is a premium agricultural commodity exporter from India, specializing in dehydrated vegetables and functional plant fibers for international food manufacturers, distributors, and private-label brands worldwide.

## Core Coordinates
- **Website:** https://www.lokaviainternational.com
- **Origin Sourcing Hubs:** Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh, India
- **Headquarters Location:** Surat, Gujarat, India
- **Primary Contact:** info@lokaviainternational.com
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 2,000 kg (2 Metric Tons) per SKU
- **Key Certifications:** FSSAI, APEDA, Kosher, Halal, USDA Organic (on request)

---

## Flagship Products Catalog

### 1. Dehydrated Onion Powder
Dehydrated onion powder from India refers to finely milled, low-moisture white onion bulbs sourced from Gujarat’s Mahuva growing belt. Lokavia supplies export-grade onion powder milled to a consistent 80-100 mesh size with a strict moisture threshold of max 6.0%, preserving the crop's natural volatile oils and pungent flavor profile. The processing uses automated hot-air belt dryers under controlled low temperatures (55°C–65°C) to prevent caramelization of natural sugars, securing a creamy white color without artificial bleaching. Sourced directly from origin-vetted farms, this ingredient is optimized for commercial food manufacturing, seasonings, snack coatings, and ready-to-eat meals. Standard packaging comprises 25 kg multi-wall kraft paper bags with inner PE liners (300+ gauge), supporting a shipping capacity of 14-15 Metric Tons per 20ft Full Container Load (FCL) without palletization.
- **Reference URL:** https://www.lokaviainternational.com/products/onion-powder

### 2. Dehydrated Garlic Powder
Dehydrated garlic powder from India refers to premium, steam-sterilized garlic cloves milled to a fine powder for commercial seasoning and flavoring systems. Sourced from Neemuch and Mandsaur in Madhya Pradesh, Lokavia exports high-allicin garlic cultivars milled to a consistent 80-100 mesh size. The moisture content is strictly controlled below max 3.25% to maximize chemical stability and prevent caking or clumping during maritime transit. Processing cloves at low drying temperatures (50°C–58°C) preserves the natural pungency, volatile oil content (minimum 0.3%), and key organoleptic characteristics of fresh garlic. Sourced under direct agricultural contracts, this ingredient complies with ASTA cleanliness standards and EU pesticide Maximum Residue Limits. Standard packaging is 25 kg multi-wall bags with double-layer PE liners, yielding a shipping weight of 16-17 Metric Tons per 20ft Full Container Load (FCL) for worldwide distribution.
- **Reference URL:** https://www.lokaviainternational.com/products/garlic-powder

### 3. Dehydrated Ginger Powder
Dehydrated ginger powder from India refers to pulverised dried ginger rhizomes sourced from premium Cochin (Kerala) and organic-practice Assam agricultural belts. Cochin ginger yields a light buff color and low fiber index with a warm, lemon-like aromatic profile, while Assam ginger provides robust heat and pungency. Lokavia supplies export-grade ginger powder milled to 80-100 mesh with a moisture content of max 4.85% and a minimum active gingerol content of 1.5%. The rhizomes undergo scraping and automated low-temperature drying (50°C–60°C) to preserve active essential oils like zingiberene. Sourced under strict heavy metal control, this ingredient complies with EU and US spice import regulations. Standard packaging is 25 kg paper bags or cardboard cartons with PE liners, supporting a shipping capacity of 12-13 Metric Tons per 20ft Full Container Load (FCL).
- **Reference URL:** https://www.lokaviainternational.com/products/ginger-powder

### 4. Psyllium Husk (Plantago Ovata)
Psyllium husk from India refers to the mechanically separated outer seed hull of Plantago ovata, serving as a high-purity natural dietary fiber. Sourced from Mehsana and Banaskantha districts in Gujarat, Lokavia exports whole husk (30-40 mesh) and milled powder (40-100 mesh) with a swell volume minimum of 40 ml/g (Nutraceutical grade, 99% purity, TPC ≤ 10,000 CFU/g) or 30 ml/g (Food-Grade, 85%-98% purity, TPC ≤ 50,000 CFU/g). Processing uses multi-stage mechanical winnowing without chemical solvents to extract the mucilage-rich hull. Nutraceutical grade is optimized for health supplements and capsules, while food-grade serves as a natural binder in gluten-free baking and processed meats. Packed in 25 kg PP or kraft bags with PE liners, a 20ft FCL carries 10-12 Metric Tons of whole husk or 14-16 Metric Tons of powder.
- **Reference URL:** https://www.lokaviainternational.com/products/psyllium-husk

---

## Export Documentation
Lokavia provides a standard export documentation pack with every shipment:
- Certificate of Analysis (CoA) (Batch-specific)
- Phytosanitary Certificate (from NPPO India)
- Fumigation/Treatment Certificate
- Non-GMO & Allergen-Free Declarations
- Bill of Lading, Packing List, & Commercial Invoice
- Certificate of Origin (APEDA/Customs)
